method: Static trace from main domain registrars and EWA facade; imports, literal bounded loops and router aggregation resolved without executing application code.
limitations: No ASGI runtime, authorization or response validation performed.
Host-based Site Studio ASGI gateway and arbitrary dynamic route construction require separate inspection; literal add_api_route loops and split register_*_routes(router) functions are traced.
Static registration does not establish that deployed services use this revision.
Condition expressions are recorded; their runtime values are not evaluated.
